outputs.explanation: Panel A shows spatial deconvolution micrographs overlaid with color-coded values, not a summary plot of averages requiring individual data points.
Box plots for each cell population have individual data points (dots) overlaid, showing the underlying distribution.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots showing running enrichment scores, not summary bar/box plots requiring individual point overlays.

Panel D is a bar chart showing log2 fold change values for multiple genes without any individual data points overlaid; as a bar chart of aggregated/derived values it should show underlying data or at least error bars/replicates, none of which are present.
Panel E consists of H&E and IHC micrograph/photograph images, not a summary plot.
